claims.text: Both 220.117.241.87 and h64-187-1-131.gtconnect.net exhibit a similar pattern of failed login attempts, with each IP address attempting to authenticate as the root user over a short period of time.

The duration of these attempts is approximately 2 minutes for 220.117.241.87 and 3 minutes for h64-187-1-131.gtconnect.net, with both IP addresses attempting to log in at a rate of around 1-2 attempts per second.
This rapid succession of failed login attempts suggests a coordinated effort to brute-force the system, rather than a series of isolated, individual attempts.
The fact that both IP addresses exhibit this same pattern of behavior suggests that they may be part of a larger, organized effort to compromise the system.

The more anomalous of the two, h64-187-1-131.gtconnect.net, appears to have a slightly longer duration of failed login attempts, and a slightly higher rate of attempts per second, suggesting that it may be the more aggressive of the two.
However, the root cause of this behavior is not immediately clear, and further investigation would be necessary to determine the underlying cause of these failed login attempts.
